useWhen: Coordinate B2B Requests for Quotation: open an RFQ stating a buyer's need, receive suppliers' quotes, and record the buyer-side human's award. Publish observable quote rankings sellers can reproduce.
avoidWhen: Picking a winner automatically, adjudicating disputes, moving money or keys, filing customs declarations, or treating an unreceived quote as an offer.

inputs.rfq: buyer, currency (ISO-4217), lines of canonical product ids with quantities, invited supplier party ids, attachment descriptors
inputs.quote: supplier party id, currency matching the RFQ, per-line unit prices, lead time in days
inputs.award: received quote id plus the deciding buyer-side human

outputs.rfq-record: open RFQ with accumulated quotes, append-only
outputs.ranking: quotes ordered by the observable key [total, lead-time, quote-id], never a winner

authority.binding: Owning repository actor profile and host-bound policy; award publication by caller authorization. No automated adjudication (ADR-2607264000 D5).

validation.runtime: kbb SCI suite: governor HARD checks plus langgraph operation graph with human approval interrupt

compatibilityNote: Actual profile and executable remain in the owning repository. A registry template neither installs the bot nor binds provider/model, inference rail, or enables a cron.
